name: zi
displayName: ZI — Prompt to Plan to Execute
description: Turn a rough idea into a refined prompt and a verified implementation plan through context-cleared phases (prompt → plan), with an independent subagent verifying the plan; or run the whole prompt → plan → execute pipeline one-shot with /zi:task, which relays stage questions to you and commits on pass. Plus an overnight-loop prompt generator, a code locator, and git stage/commit helpers.
